title: Fractional rollout window
provenance: Deterministic teaching example: 71 states and 70 grow, Ready, or old-removal actions.
Preserves the teaching schedule from the fractional-window documentation in upstream PR #1224.
Not a recorded cluster run. The production planner can propose several changes together.
Old removal and new requested growth use separate coordination windows. The visible window follows old removal.

source.format: Finite Canvas primitives, original state boundaries, 24fps sampled decorative motion. No domain calculations at playback.
